alphaRule: Tight crop includes every pixel whose alpha channel is greater than 0; no low-alpha threshold was applied.
coordinateSystem: Pixel coordinates use the original uncropped canvas with origin at the top-left. right and bottom are exclusive.
positioningNote: To preserve the original placement after cropping, position each cropped sprite at original anchor + offset.x and original anchor + offset.y.

finderDateAdded.note: mdls and the com.apple.metadata:kMDItemDateAdded xattr did not expose Finder Date Added in this shell. nativeDirectoryIndex records os.listdir order captured before cropping; birthTime/modifiedTime record filesystem timestamps captured before cropping.
